title: eDNA Extraction Using Phenol-Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol
author: Abigail Wells
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bx4ypqxw

steps.title: Heat‑shock filters in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Place filters in 2 mL of Longmire lysis buffer and heat‑shock at 95 °C for 5 minutes (00:05:00), then allow the samples to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add proteinase K for digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL proteinase K to each tube to obtain a final concentration of 1 mg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Incubate digestion mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 56 °C while shaking at 120 rpm for 2 hours (02:00:00).

steps.title: Prepare phase‑lock tubes with grease
steps.instruction: Using a syringe, add approximately 800 µL of vacuum grease onto the inner wall of each 5 mL tube, avoiding contact with the lysate to prevent cross‑contamination. (The same amount of grease can be pre‑filled into two empty tubes for later use.)

steps.title: Add phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl (ratio 25:24:1) adjusted to pH 8 (pH is critical for good results) to each tube.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge first extraction
steps.instruction: Shake the tubes vigorously, then centrifuge at 13 300 × g, 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add chloroform‑isoamyl to aqueous phase
steps.instruction: While the tubes are still in the centrifuge, carefully decant the aqueous (upper) layer from step 6 into a new tube, then add 2.2 mL of chloroform‑isoamyl (24:1). Add the chloroform only immediately before use so it does not interfere with the phase‑lock grease.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge second extraction
steps.instruction: Shake the tubes well and centrifuge again at 13 300 × g, 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: To the recovered aqueous layer, add 2 mL of isopropanol (pre‑filled if desired) and 80 µL of 5 M NaCl, then mix gently.

steps.title: Pellet DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 13 300 × g, 4 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash pellet with cold ethanol
steps.instruction: Carefully pour off the supernatant, then add 800 µL of ice‑cold 70 % (v/v) ethanol to the pellet.

steps.title: Centrifuge after ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Shake briefly and centrifuge at 13 300 × g, 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Pour off the ethanol slowly and allow the tubes to air‑dry for 1 hour or until completely dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 100 µL TE buffer pre‑warmed to 37 °C to favor elution.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Store the final DNA solution at –20 °C to –80 °C.
